title: chant.run/v1
description: The head every run report in a CI product's report store shares: a stage's report or a commit's run view. The body is the product's own. A product-named id (terragucci.report/v1, terragucci.run/v1) is read as the same kind, its product named by the id. Within v1 fields are only added, and an existing field never changes meaning.

product.description: The product that wrote it. Required under chant.run/v1.
